heading: Pigalle by Villamoura the home of Exceptional Seafood and Grills
taglineHeading: Nestled in the heart of Sandton at Nelson Mandela Square, Pigalle by Villamoura offers more than just a meal — it’s an experience.

reviews.text: A very pleasant eating experience. What is a little bit difficult to find as there are no signs and many of the security guards did not know the place. The service was excellent, and the waiters were very courteous. The manager came to check if everything was OK, which is really exceptional. The food was very tasty and the portions generous. The free tasting of the butternut soup was a nice addition. Just note – that a 10% service charges charge is included in your bill, but they still placed at the bottom for gratuity. Usually a service charges levied then they should be no gratuity.
reviews.author: Sulaimaan Ibn Umar

reviews.text: Pigalle in Sandton exceeded all my expectations. From the moment we were seated, the atmosphere was warm and stylish, with a décor that feels both elegant and inviting. The food was absolutely amazing—each dish arrived beautifully presented and packed with flavor, making it a memorable dining experience. Our waiter, Mr. Charls, was a standout. His easy smile and friendly demeanor made conversation effortless, and he checked in just enough to ensure everything was perfect without being intrusive. A gentleman who appeared to be either the owner or the manager also stopped by to ask how we were enjoying our meal. His genuine interest and attentive service added a special touch, especially since it was my first visit. To top it all off, it was my birthday, and the team surprised me with a gorgeous ice‑cream dessert that was as delightful as the rest of the night. Feeling blessed to have discovered Pigalle, I can’t wait to return and enjoy more of their culinary delights. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food, excellent service, and a celebratory vibe. 5/5*⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.author: manjit singh

reviews.text: Great service from Sabelo. He went out of our way to make our Anniversary special. Thank you for the wonderful experience and delicious food!
reviews.author: lutfiyya ebrahim

reviews.text: Pigalle Restaurant in Sandton offers a refined dining experience, perfect for those looking to enjoy a blend of Mediterranean and continental cuisine in an elegant setting. The restaurant boasts a sophisticated ambiance, with stylish decor and attentive service. The menu features a wide range of dishes, from fresh seafood to premium steaks, all prepared with high-quality ingredientsl. Pigalle is ideal for special occasions or an indulgent night out, with its luxurious atmosphere and exceptional culinary offerings making it a standout in Sandton's vibrant dining scene. Book ahead, we did a last minute booking and were seated kind of outside the restaurant. That was not so nice but the food made up for it.
reviews.author: Paul Govender

reviews.text: 5 star venue for sure. Not only because of the great setup and service. The food is just so consistently good. My pictures show a few visits, each time served so consistently. The escargot is bang on perfect, exactly as I like it all the time. The butternut soup pre starter is divine. You just cannot go wrong with any seafood here, all of it. Their years of experience shows on the plates and the well polished service. A must visit in gauteng.
reviews.author: Dan Moodley

faqs.question: Do I need to make a reservation?
faqs.answer: Reservations are recommended, especially on weekends, but walk-ins are always welcome.

faqs.question: Is your restaurant kid-friendly?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We have a kids’ menu and high chairs available for young diners.

faqs.question: Do you accommodate food allergies?
faqs.answer: Yes, please inform our staff about any allergies, and we will do our best to accommodate your needs.

faqs.question: Do you offer takeaways or deliveries?
faqs.answer: We offer both takeaway and delivery through selected food delivery services.

faqs.question: Can I host a private event at your restaurant?
faqs.answer: Yes! We have spaces available for private parties and corporate events. Please contact us to discuss options and availability.
